note: Every product fact on this site points at one of these sources. 'fetched' means the full page text was retrieved and read in this session (2026-11-20). 'excerpt' means only a search-result excerpt of the official page was available; the wording should be re-checked by hand before it is relied on. 'observed' means a value read off an Amazon page on a dated fetch; observations can change without notice. Nothing in this register is a third-party blog or review site.

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.used_for: Section 5 requires the exact statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.'; Section 1 defines Special Links and the tagged-link requirement.
sources.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site ...: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Commission Income Statement, Participation Requirements, IP License, Trademark Guidelines)
sources.used_for: Participation Requirements §2(a)-(b): Special Links must carry the Associates tag as a URL parameter and must be accessed directly from the site. §2(b) price clause: a site may show price and availability only if Amazon serves that data or it comes from the Creators/PA API. Also the anti-misleading-claims clause and the trademark rules.
sources.quote: All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site. ... you must include your Associates ID or "tag" ... as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies: price and availability clause (§2(b))
sources.used_for: The reason no price, star rating or availability figure is published anywhere on this site: the site does not use Amazon-served price data or the Creators/PA API.
sources.quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API

sources.title: 16 CFR 255.5 - Disclosure of material connections
sources.used_for: Why the disclosure sits above the fold on every page: a material connection must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously, and an affiliate commission is a material connection (Example 11).
sources.quote: When there exists a connection between the endorser and the seller of the advertised product that might materially affect the weight or credibility of the endorsement, and that connection is not reasonably expected by the audience, such connection must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously.

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 - Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising (full part)
sources.used_for: The rule that the disclosure must be in the same place as the endorsement, not buried on a separate page.

sources.title: Google Search spam policies (including scaled content abuse and site reputation abuse)
sources.used_for: The reason this site publishes a small number of hand-checked pages rather than auto-generated pages at scale, and the reason every page has a named publisher and a contact route. Google lists affiliate links used throughout a page, with links qualified properly, among practices that are not inconsistent with its site reputation policy.
